elements.requirement: Corporation tax is charged on the profits of companies for any financial year for which an Act provides for such a charge.
elements.quote: Corporation tax is charged on profits of companies for any financial year for which an Act so provides

elements.requirement: In the Part containing section 2 of the Corporation Tax Act 2009, "profits" means income and chargeable gains, except to the extent that the context otherwise requires.
elements.quote: “profits” means income and chargeable gains, except in so far as the context otherwise requires

elements.requirement: In the Corporation Tax Act 2009, "the charge to corporation tax on income" means the statutory charge on the profits of companies to the extent that it relates to income.
elements.quote: “the charge to corporation tax on income” means the charge under subsection (1) so far as relating to income

elements.requirement: The charge to corporation tax on income operates in accordance with the provisions of the Corporation Tax Acts that govern its application.
elements.quote: The charge to corporation tax on income has effect in accordance with the provisions of the Corporation Tax Acts that deal with its application

thresholds.what: the period for which corporation tax is charged on company profits if an Act so provides
thresholds.quote: for any financial year for which an Act so provides
